title: B003: TRI-27 ISA — Coptic Alphabet Ternary Instruction Set v6.3
description: TRI-27 ISA uses Coptic alphabet (27 letters) for ternary instruction encoding. 27 registers (3 banks × 9), stack-based bytecode, {-1,0,+1} operand format. Opcodes: MOV, JGT, JLT, JUMP, CALL, RET, PUSH, POP, BIND, BUNDLE, PERMUTE. ECE: 0.115, Brier Score: 0.248 (Good calibration).
